title: NR Radio Protocol Stack Architecture
overview: NR stack mirrors LTE: C-Plane (signaling) and U-Plane (user data) share PHY→MAC→RLC→PDCP; U-Plane adds SDAP→UPF, C-Plane adds RRC→NAS→AMF. Based on TS 38.300 (RAN) and TS 23.501 (5GC).

u_plane.label: User plane
u_plane.note: SA data sessions; SDAP maps QoS flows (5QI) to DRBs.

c_plane.label: Control plane
c_plane.note: Attach, registration, security, RRC reconfiguration, capability exchange.

message_flow_summary: App on UE generates data → modem/AP encode
RF frontend transmits over the air
Core routes to internet / data server

l2_overview.downlink_u_plane: Per-carrier SDAP → PDCP → RLC → multiplex/schedule in common MAC (CA from day one in NR)
l2_overview.uplink_u_plane: Same as DL except UL does not support CA in L2 structure per ShareTechnote
l2_overview.ca_note: Each CC processed separately in SDAP/PDCP/RLC; MAC schedules across carriers

layers.name: PHY
layers.test_use: RF/drive-test KPIs, sync/cell search, BLER, RSRP/SINR at physical channels

layers.name: MAC
layers.test_use: HARQ failures, UL grant issues, PRACH/RACH debug

layers.name: RLC
layers.test_use: Retransmission loops, throughput collapse with good RF

layers.name: PDCP
layers.test_use: Security mode, capa segmentation (ULDedicatedMessageSegment), DRB setup

layers.name: RRC
layers.test_use: Attach checklist, HO failures, reconfig reject

layers.name: NAS (5GMM/5GSM)
layers.test_use: Registration reject, auth failure, PDU session setup

troubleshooting.symptom: Data works but signaling fails (or vice versa)
checks: Determine C-Plane vs U-Plane — separate SRB/DRB and NAS vs SDAP paths
Check if RRC connected but PDU session missing (NAS/SMF path)
Verify PDCP security active on DRB before user traffic

troubleshooting.symptom: Failure after RRC but before IP address
checks: Trace NAS: Registration → PDU Session Establishment (SMF/UPF)
RRC may be OK while 5GSM fails — not an RF-only issue
Descend stack: PHY (CQI/BLER) → MAC (HARQ) → RLC (retransmissions) → PDCP/SDAP (DRB/QoS)
Confirm CA/SCell active if testing aggregated throughput
